display_name: 多相加速盲信道恢复源训练
description: 独立训练与盲信道展开恢复同结构、同源配置的多相卷积实现；浮点轨迹和最终预测需要独立验证。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 GPU3 deterministic FP32 TF32 off, GPU polyphase source training and recovery, frozen CPU reader and CPU truth-last

data.version: fixed source training cache epochs21/22/23; source diagnostic epoch19
data.representation: Paired source received and clean IQ only; no DURA context
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 32768 source physical IDs selected excluding RX4/6/8 day3 and 672 pilot IDs; L_s/U_s TX labels hidden

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Source-only 64-record direct optimizer smoke without DURA/F; separate 112-record frozen DURA and reader no-query evaluation preflight

permissions.claim_scope: F-free/TX-label-free paired source IQ training; F used only in separate source no-query preflight and frozen ground evaluation

checkpoint.initialization: Fresh blind model initialized using same seed and architecture as original; polyphase convolution preserves parameter objects; no weights loaded from original
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Same legal 32768 source IDs and epochs21/22/23; source received/clean IQ only, no DURA/F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fresh source-only training under matching input contract; original run is a comparison only, no inherited checkpoint or target feedback
checkpoint.selection_rule: Final epoch20 fixed before test, no target or source-score model selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU3 one this-task worker, >=8192 MiB free and fewer than 3 total GPU apps per phase; preserve original healthy run and all other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner on source role or contract mismatch, nonfinite output, checkpoint mismatch, target or F/TX leakage, output collision, failed no-query source smoke, or systemic technical failure; preserve other owners and artifacts.

rows.method: Same 33-tap blind channel and four residual updates; replace 23 dilated 5-tap convolutions by phase-split convolution; no assumed exact floating-point identity
rows.purpose: Train only on authorized source paired IQ; no F/TX/V/target input
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026110903, fixed source fit 2026110611, order 2026110904, evaluation 2026092701; no other checkpoint initialization.
rows.budget_ref: 8365004 trainable parameters; 32768 legal physical IDs x 3 source views x 20 epochs, batch32

notes: Independent implementation and run; the original training and evaluation continue untouched.
Identical mathematical convolution but different floating-point reduction order, so final predictions are not assumed bitwise identical.

Random synthetic GPU3 benchmark 4 steps: native mean 2.5634 s vs polyphase mean 0.0958 s; max output difference 2.39e-7, maximum parameter-gradient difference 1.50e-8. Not an end-to-end training benchmark.
No DURA/F/TX/V/target in training; full seven-view Phase1 ground predictions before independent truth-last; historical test exposed.
